prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Spectrum 2-1: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F2C, accent #861D24, secondary surface #EDEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Inter; narrow display hierarchy with neutral body text. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 20px, heading 64px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
